The '''Ord Torrenze system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Torrenze]].
